rows.$note: THE MOST IMPORTANT ROW IN THIS FILE. The contract says four hours. The laboratory takes six. A fit built on the contract would compute deadlines that are two hours optimistic on every case — and would be wrong in the direction that loses organs. Encode what happens. Cite the contract so the gap is visible and can be renegotiated.
